verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own continuous queries are SQL statements that run continuously on incoming data in real time and write or export output rows to destinations. That amounts to an event-driven rule (a SQL filter/transform) producing automatic output. Scheduled load jobs and Dataform schedules are time-based, so they are not event triggers. Missing for 10: a documented list of action destinations (e.g., messaging or downstream invocation), an explicit rule/trigger model beyond SQL output, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
